def transform(grid):
    n = len(grid)
    clockwise = [[grid[n - 1 - c][r] for c in range(n)] for r in range(n)]
    half_turn = [row[::-1] for row in grid[::-1]]
    counterclockwise = [[grid[c][n - 1 - r] for c in range(n)] for r in range(n)]
    return [grid[r] + clockwise[r] for r in range(n)] + [counterclockwise[r] + half_turn[r] for r in range(n)]
